**AGENTS instructions:** No AGENTS.md exists anywhere in /root/w33d_infra/sluice (Glob `**/AGENTS.md` → no files). Nothing to apply.

## File:line map

**Authorization context signing (internal/auth/)**
- internal/auth/authz_context.go:13-19 — X-Auth-Permission/Object/Decision/Decision-Id/Revocation-Epoch/Context-Timestamp/Context-Sig header constants
- internal/auth/authz_context.go:24-31 — `AuthorizationContext` struct (Permission, Object, Decision, DecisionID, RevocationEpoch, Timestamp; **no evidence/source_grant_id field**)
- internal/auth/authz_context.go:33-40 — context get/set (`AuthorizationFromContext`, `ContextWithAuthorization`)
- internal/auth/authz_context.go:44-65 — `SignAuthorizationContext`: frozen newline-delimited canonical v1, rejects `\r\n` fields, returns "" if key empty or Decision != "Allow"
- internal/auth/authz_context_test.go:10-27 — canonical v1 golden test + newline rejection
- internal/auth/sig.go:14,20,44,65,90 — v1 identity/PAT/zone signing (`SignIdentity`, `SignPATScope`, `SignGatewayZone`) — must stay preserved

**Call site (internal/gateway/)**
- internal/gateway/server.go:66,69,72,80 — `GatewayHMACKey`/`GatewayZoneHMACKey`/`GatewayAuthzHMACKey`/`MFAAssertionHMACKey` options; server.go:145 wiring; server.go:213 fail-closed when authorizer enabled but authz key empty
- internal/gateway/proxy.go:49,101-108 — v1 identity + PAT-scope sig injection (unchanged); proxy.go:110-119 — authz context signed/injected only when `AuthorizationFromContext` present
- internal/gateway/proxy_test.go:359 — `TestAllowedPermissionContextIsSignedAndSpoofedHeadersAreReplaced`; 209-237, 315-355 — v1 PAT/identity sig tests

**HMAC key config & validation (internal/config/)**
- config.go:162-165 — env names `GATEWAY_HMAC_KEY`, `GATEWAY_ZONE_HMAC_KEY`, `GATEWAY_AUTHZ_HMAC_KEY`; config.go:144 MFA key env
- config.go:376-384 — JSON fields; config.go:608-617 — env overlay
- config.go:711-717 — distinctness validators (zone ≠ identity; authz ≠ identity/zone); 729-743 — verdict token distinct from gateway secrets; 745-759 — revocation token ≥32B and distinct
- internal/config/config_test.go:26-34, 424-441 — env overlay/validation tests

**Verdict v2 DTO parsing (internal/rbac/)**
- internal/rbac/permission.go:38-44 — `permissionCheckResponse` DTO: decision/reason/epoch/evaluated_at/**evidence `[]json.RawMessage`**; **no source_grant_id field** (grep for `source_grant_id|SourceGrantID` repo-wide: zero matches)
- permission.go:112-139 — POST `{VerdictURL}/api/v2/check`, Bearer token, bounded body `io.LimitReader(response.Body, 1<<20)` at :127, `DisallowUnknownFields()` at :128 (adding fields to Verdict responses will break decode), metadata/decision validation :133-138
- permission.go:142-155 — `permissionDecisionID` sha256 digest (no evidence input)
- Tests: permission_test.go:14-93 (Allow/Deny/503 with `"evidence":[]`), rbac_test.go, trusted_mfa_test.go:23

**cmd/**
- cmd/sluice/main.go:146-151 — passes GatewayHMACKey/GatewayAuthzHMACKey/MFAAssertionHMACKey into gateway options

## Summary
Authz context is HMAC-signed via `SignAuthorizationContext` (authz_context.go:44) and injected in proxy.go:110; keys configured/validated in config.go:376-384/711-717; Verdict v2 DTO (permission.go:38-44) carries `evidence` as raw messages but `source_grant_id` exists nowhere in the codebase — and `DisallowUnknownFields` means adding it server-side would break parsing.
